messages:
Evelyn (customer): Hey team — after upgrading to @redwood/sdk 0.22.0 my Node client started failing. TypeScript compile error: 'Property \"chat\" does not exist on type Client' and API calls return 404 for chat.create. Rolling back to 0.21.2 fixes it. Anyone seen this?

Jules (support): Sorry you're hitting this, can you paste your package.json deps + the minimal code that fails and the exact runtime error (node + npm/yarn)? Also which region/host are you hitting?

Evelyn (customer): package.json deps: 
```json
{"name":"repro","version":"1.0.0","dependencies":{"@redwood/inference":"0.22.0","node":"^18.0.0"}}
```
Code: 
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.chat.create({ session: 'user-123', model: 'redwood/gpt-small', prompt: 'hi' });
```
TS error (tsc): Property 'chat' does not exist on type 'Client'.
Runtime curl result we saw when calling via SDK (server-side):
```
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
Content-Type: application/json
{ \"error\": \"route not found: /v1/chat.create\" }
```

Jules (support): thanks. @Ravi can you take a quick look — sounds like a route/SDK mismatch.

Ravi (eng): I reproduced locally with the published 0.22.0 bundle. We unintentionally published a build where route shims were removed. In the new client the method surface changed to top-level names (client.createChat(...)) and the param name 'session' was renamed to 'conversationId'. The TypeScript types reflect that, so older code hits compile/runtime errors. This was not supposed to be a breaking change.

Ravi (eng): Quick repro steps for engineering:
1) npm i @redwood/inference@0.22.0
2) node repro.js with the snippet Evelyn posted
You should see the TS error or the 404 calling /v1/chat.create.

Ravi (eng): Workarounds:
- Pin to @redwood/inference@0.21.2 (immediately safe).
- Update call to use new signature: 
```ts
await client.createChat({ conversationId: 'user-123', model: 'redwood/gpt-small', prompt: 'hi' });
```
- Or call REST directly: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/create with body using conversationId.

Jules (support): Logged a GH issue and flagged release team. Can you publish a compat patch? Also adding repro steps to the support ticket.

Ravi (eng): Publishing 0.22.1 with the compatibility shim now. It reintroduces client.chat.* aliases and keeps the TS types backward compatible. ETA ~20m. I'll include tests so shims stay.

release-bot: Published @redwood/inference@0.22.1 — includes compatibility shims for chat.create and aliasing of 'session' -> 'conversationId'. Changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/releases/tag/v0.22.1

Evelyn (customer): Verified — upgraded to 0.22.1 and original code works again. Thanks :thumbsup:

Jules (support): Closing this thread, linking to GH #3345 and internal postmortem. If anyone sees similar route drift please ping #eng-runtime.
